# FreeSCP

> FreeSCP is a free, open-source, cross-platform SFTP/SCP/FTP/FTPS/WebDAV/SMB file-transfer client for Windows, macOS and Linux, with an embedded Telnet console, a pure-Rust core (russh, russh-sftp, suppaftp, reqwest, smb2) and a Slint-based desktop UI. Released under the MIT license.

FreeSCP is a cross-platform file-transfer client focused on simplicity and
security. It connects over SFTP, SCP, FTP, FTPS, WebDAV and SMB/CIFS
(SMB2/SMB3), and supports SSH jump hosts, SOCKS5/HTTP-CONNECT proxies and
Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) hosts through standard OpenSSH ProxyCommand
entries in ~/.ssh/config. An embedded Telnet console (plain TCP and TLS)
provides a VT100/VT220 terminal with scrollback, copy/paste, NAWS resizing
and optional auto-login.

## Features

- Transfer backends: SFTP, SCP (SSH jump hosts, cloudflared tunnels,
  SOCKS5/HTTP-CONNECT proxies), FTP, FTPS, WebDAV, SMB/CIFS (SMB2/SMB3;
  no SMB1, proxy, or jump-host support)
- Telnet console: plain TCP and TLS, VT100/VT220 terminal, scrollback,
  copy/paste, NAWS window resizing, optional auto-login
- File manager: transfer queue, integrity verification, drag & drop,
  permissions editor, remote search
- Site manager: SSH config import, connection history, keychain-backed secret
  storage
- SSH connectivity: SSH jump hosts and Cloudflare Tunnel hosts via standard
  ~/.ssh/config ProxyCommand entries (e.g. `cloudflared access ssh`)
- Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared): add a line such as
  `ProxyCommand cloudflared access ssh --hostname ssh.example.com` to the
  host's entry in ~/.ssh/config and import it from the site manager; FreeSCP
  honors the proxy command when opening SFTP/SCP connections and terminal
  sessions, with no extra setup inside the app
- Localizations: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese

## Supported protocols

- SFTP: supported (SSH jump hosts, cloudflared tunnels)
- SCP: supported (SSH jump hosts, cloudflared tunnels, SOCKS5/HTTP-CONNECT
  proxies)
- FTP: supported
- FTPS: supported
- WebDAV: supported
- SMB/CIFS: supported (SMB2/SMB3; no SMB1, proxy, or jump host)
- Telnet: supported (plain TCP and TLS console)

## Download

- [Prebuilt binaries (GitHub Releases)](https://github.com/NOXCIS/FreeSCP/releases)
- Build from source: `git clone https://github.com/NOXCIS/FreeSCP.git && cd FreeSCP && cargo build --workspace && cargo run -p freescp-app`
